body.cap: A view of the entrance of the CES 2024 Unveiled event held at the Mandalay Bay Hotel in Las Vegas, USA, on January 7th (local time). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: On January 7th, just before the grand opening of CES 2024, the world's largest consumer electronics and IT exhibition, the highly anticipated "CES Unveiled" event occurred at the Mandalay Bay Hotel in Las Vegas. Unveiled is a significant event where companies display innovative and advanced products, known as the pre-show showcase of CES. This year's Unveiled brought together global media, company representatives, government officials, and key players in the tech industry.

The event featured over 180 companies showcasing their flagship products, including startups, major corporations, and niche businesses. Seven enterprises under the Seoul Business Agency (SBA) banner – Enhance, Hurotics, LordSystem, DNA Corporation, Solive Ventures, BarunBio, and Nation A – participated. Others like HL Mando, LG, Luxnine, WIRobotics, GeoGrid, and 10Minds also unveiled their line-ups
From 5 PM to 8:30 PM local time, foreign media and buyers flocked to the event, showing great interest in Korean startups. The Korean startup booths were particularly busy, attracting many visitors.

body.cap: Broadcaster Alex Sigrist is interviewing a representative from Hurotics at CES 2024 Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News
LG Booth at the CES Unveiled 2024 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: A highlight was the Hurotics booth, which presented the 'H-Flex' series, which are walking-assist robots. The booth saw an unending stream of attendees eager to try the product, which is equipable in under 30 seconds and improves walking efficiency by about 20%.

LG, the only major corporation in attendance, showcased the new LG Gram Pro and 2in1, along with the 2024 UltraGear OLED Gaming Monitor – the first to support two resolutions and refresh rates on a single monitor.

Leo Thevenet, editor-in-chief of the French IT and AI media outlet 'Le Café du Geek,' commented that this year's Unveiled featured many Asian startups, particularly from China and Japan, with Korean startups standing out in various fields. He noted the exceptionally high interest in European markets for Korean biotech and health-related technologies.

Additionally, AVING News, in collaboration with SBA, presented the main products of the seven participating companies with broadcaster Alex Sigrist, who introduced them in both English and Korean. These videos were tailored for each participating company and uploaded on the official YouTube channel of the exhibition, aiding in their promotion.

body.cap: Broadcaster Alex Sigrist is interviewing representatives from Soliv Ventures, Enhance, BarunBio, DNA Corporation, Nation A, and LordSystem at CES 2024 Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The Consumer Technology Association (CTA), host of CES, showcases the latest trends in the consumer electronics industry in Las Vegas every January. AVING News, covering CES for 18 consecutive years, has been broadcasting CES news globally since 2006. They also annually select and highlight the 'BEST OF CES' and 'BEST OF MADE IN KOREA' products, companies, and technologies.

The CES 2024 Seoul Pavilion, operating on its most enormous scale since Seoul's first CES participation in 2020, is a joint effort of 13 organizations, including SBA, Seoul Bio Hub, Campus Town, AI Yangjae Hub, Gwanak District, Yonsei University, Korea University, Chung-Ang University, Sogang University, Kookmin University, Hanyang University, Konkuk University, and Kyung Hee University. This collaborative pavilion marks a significant step in Seoul's ambition to become a startup hub, and among its participating companies, 17 received innovation awards, evidencing their excellence. The pavilion also includes 85 supporters in a significant collaboration between companies, institutions, and industry-academia cooperation.
